title: Blue Oracle with Scythe
description: A blue-skinned female figure with golden cracks on her face and flowing dark hair streaked with gold sits at an ornate white table. She holds a tall ornate spear in one hand and a scythe in the other, with an open glowing book emitting blue magic in front of her alongside gold coins and a crystal ball.
prompt: A mystical blue-skinned female figure with golden cracks across her face and ornate golden lion earrings, wearing dark armor with lion motifs, sits centered at a white ornate table. She holds a tall decorated spear in her right hand and a scythe in her left. An open book emits bright blue magical energy on the table next to a glowing crystal ball and piles of gold coins. The background is a fantasy study with green and pink walls covered in floating scrolls, potion bottles on shelves, framed cosmic paintings, and a glowing chandelier above. Surreal fantasy style, rich detail, dramatic lighting.
